# Book of Giants Fragment 3 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Book of Giants Fragment 3 (Ohya's Dream of the Garden) where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 3:3 — "exceedingly great / vast beyond measure"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-garden was-exceedingly-great" — literal Aramaic sagi |
| LOGOS | "the garden was exceedingly great" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "The garden was vast beyond measure" — paraphrastic expansion |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "exceedingly great." The Aramaic sagi simply means "exceedingly" and does not warrant PNEUMA's expansion "beyond measure."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 3:9 — "beasts of the field / wild animal"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-beasts-of the-field" — literal cheyват bara' |
| LOGOS | "the beasts of the field" — formal biblical register |
| PNEUMA | "Every wild animal" — dynamic equivalent |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "the beasts of the field." This is established biblical idiom (cf. Gen 2:19-20) and the Aramaic echoes that tradition deliberately.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 3:15 — "awoke from my sleep / woke up"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "I-awoke from-my-sleep" — literal |
| LOGOS | "I awoke from my sleep" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "I woke up" — simplified |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "I awoke from my sleep." The fuller idiom matches the Aramaic and echoes Daniel 2.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 3:18 — "are the Watchers / represent the Watchers"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-two-hundred-trees are the-Watchers" — literal identification |
| LOGOS | "the two hundred trees are the Watchers" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "the two hundred trees represent the Watchers" — interpretive verb |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "are the Watchers." Aramaic dream interpretation uses direct identification ("X is Y"), not "represents."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements for Fragment 3: 4*
